name: Dial-Up
blurb: A screeching speed freak on a janky bike.

meta.notes: M1 box rival (ai-1). The tone guide makes him a weaver; M1 has no weaver preset yet, so he is a racer with a high weave and risk-taking: fast, erratic, swerves across his lane, dodges through the oncoming lane, and kicks more than he punches. Low health.
